OUR MASCOT

Meet Vero, your financial rescue hero

Every business has a moment where ad spend spirals and results stall. That's when Vero shows up — part guardian, part strategist, all AI — to catch the fall and turn it into growth.

NAMEVeroORIGINFy·VERO·to
Origin Story

Why Vero exists

Vero was built out of a simple frustration: too many businesses were watching their ad budgets disappear with no idea why. Fyverto's team designed Vero as the face of that fix — an AI system with a personality, built to actively step in the moment a campaign starts leaking money.

The name comes straight from Fyverto itself — the "VERO" at its center — because this mascot isn't a mascot bolted on afterward. It's the brand's mission given a face: rescue the business, then help it grow past where it started.

Vero's cape and badge aren't just style — they're a promise. Every client gets the same thing Vero represents: someone (something) actively watching their spend, ready to step in before small leaks become real losses.

Vero's powers

What Vero actually does for you

👁

Live Vision

Watches every campaign in real time, spotting waste the second it happens.

🛡

Budget Shield

Blocks spend from flowing toward audiences and placements that don't convert.

🎯

Targeting Radar

Locks onto the exact audience most likely to become paying customers.

🚀

Growth Boost

Once the leak is fixed, redirects that same energy into scaling what works.

"I don't just stop the fall. I make sure you climb higher than before."

— Vero
